scope: Yukimi component integration and resource comparison; not ISO qualification

hardware.gpu: Intel integrated graphics, PCI 8086:b090, xe driver
hardware.dedicated_vram: Not present on this integrated GPU. DRM resident GTT buffers use system RAM.
hardware.session: Private GPU-backed nested Hyprland with the shipped Tatami Lua configuration, headless 2560x1600 output at scale 2 and 60 Hz. The host session was Aizome; no physical monitor or host system configuration was changed.
hardware.method: Three fresh compositor instances per frontend. Measure 30 seconds each on settled Overview and Installed. CPU is percent of one logical core from /proc/PID/stat; PSS and private RAM from smaps_rollup; DRM fdinfo clients deduplicated by PCI device/client ID. GPU engine percentages use cycle deltas divided by total-cycle deltas. Font and system page caches were warm. Startup and cold Nixpkgs indexing are outside these intervals.
limitations: PSS can share pages with the outer Aizome session; separate Tatami-only VM measurements establish isolated RAM costs.
Graphics buffers shared by clients and the compositor are reported separately; do not add them as private VRAM or add them to PSS.
Only this Intel GPU was measured, not discrete NVIDIA/AMD VRAM or a physical Tatami login.
The native app rasterizes into shared-memory buffers; its zero direct DRM use does not mean zero compositor GPU cost.
hardware.execution: Exact remote package ELFs were extracted locally because this host cannot import unsigned remote store paths. Runtime dependencies were the same Nix store libraries. Launcher environment was reproduced, Aizome shell sockets unset, and the packaged font bundle copied byte-for-byte. The final package and hardware benchmark use identical ELF and font bytes.
hardware.median_order: Each page lists app then compositor; empty lists only compositor. Each field is the median across three trials.
hardware.incremental_pss_method: Median of each paired trial: app plus compositor PSS minus that fresh compositor's empty baseline. Global sharing and transient buffer counts can affect PSS; raw trials and ranges are retained.

validation.native_package: Passed: 28 kit tests, 41 Yukimi unit tests (one ignored), 24 headless interactions, four layout tests, two golden suites; reference images unchanged.
validation.launcher_search: 9 tests passed, including unpatched negative controls
validation.update_completion: Passed 45.19s disposable VM: live activation, interrupted client, restart selection, disk boot, native frontend launch.
validation.site: Passed final site build with the shared native icon and original Tatami capture; output /nix/store/71cz2q2b2ln895gmmnalriwr1xkgbxlz-sekka-site.
validation.tatami: Passed 261.83s disposable VM: real Apps menu, native Wayland window, all pages, real Nixpkgs search, Super+C/V clipboard forwarding, single-instance page requests, disabled Steam actions, cancelled install confirmation, real Polkit prompt and dismissal, unchanged configuration, 1920x1080 at 1.25x and 1280x800 at 1x, Ctrl+Q, socket cleanup, no coredumps. Original captures visually reviewed.
validation.x11: Passed 40.15s disposable Xfce VM: Run dialog launch, Ctrl navigation, single-instance relaunch, Ctrl+Q and outer Alt+F4 close, compositor/socket cleanup, no coredumps; original 1280x800 screenshot reviewed.
validation.isolated_memory: Passed 753.72s: three complete trials each of native and GTK on Overview and Installed, using the final frontend packages and a Tatami-only VM; original captures reviewed.
validation.flake_evaluation: Full evaluation not passed: xapp-packages asserts the legacy services.xserver.desktopManager.xfce.enable option; reproduced unchanged on current base 74316b9 as well as original base 4dc8857. Full local evaluation also encountered an invalid cached source path for iso-store-integrity; targeted evaluation passed for both original base and candidate on wx-workstation (identical derivation).
validation.authentication_note: Tatami's authentication agent reports Escape dismissal as Not authorized; Yukimi shows Permission denied / Nothing was changed. Enter activates Close on the finished operation sheet. Both application and helper remain unprivileged/privileged across the same Polkit boundary.
validation.standalone_nix: Passed non-flake callPackage evaluation; same Yukimi derivation as the root flake.
validation.formatting: Changed Nix and Rust files pass formatting; Python scripts parse; git diff --check passes. Whole Aizome cargo fmt --check also reports two untouched pre-existing files: compositor session.rs and shell menus/build.rs.

packages.closure_notes: Standalone uncompressed NAR sizes, not incremental Tatami installation sizes and not RAM. Native includes Weston for X11. No Aizome compositor/shell/other-app output in the native runtime closure. The copied font bundle has no store references; files retain their embedded metadata.
packages.font_trimming_validation: The eight font faces and Archivo license retain identical bytes; the copied output has no store references. Compared on the same pre-rebase build, trimming removed 382.3 MiB of unused families.

isolated_tatami_vm.method: Three alternating native/GTK runs in one disposable Tatami-only NixOS VM, 2560x1600 at scale 2, 12 GiB RAM, four vCPUs, software-rendered virtio graphics. The GTK baseline is an additional store path; only the selected frontend process runs. Each page gets 30 seconds of sampling. No Aizome session or native sibling apps run. Report app PSS separately from compositor caches that persist between runs. Software rendering makes guest CPU and graphics costs unsuitable for predicting physical GPU performance.

tatami_gui_resource_notes: Single 15-second intervals in the software-rendered interaction VM. Discover is sampled after the real 25,375-package index is built. Excludes the cold index subprocess; hardware comparison uses separate repeated trials.
